what: M87*: the Kerr critical curve (the shadow edge) enclosed over the stated spin range and inclination, its diameter in µas for each published mass row, its ratio to the EHT ring (COMPARED), and the ISCO clock — the black hole's decided layer (Phase 0), no render, no page

words.CERTIFIED: the enclosure lies inside the claim's interval (a printed decimal claims ± half a unit in its last digit)
words.REFUTED: the enclosure is disjoint from the claim: false, proven, given the inputs
words.REFUSED: outside the pre-registered domain, or neither inside nor disjoint at the enclosure's width
words.COMPARED: the measured ring against the decided shadow: a ratio band, never a verdict on the black hole, on GR, or on which mass is right

printing: every enclosure printed OUTWARD (design/outward.js; rationals by BigInt floor/ceiling): a lower end rounded down, an upper end up. M units at 6 decimals, µas and ratios at 4, θg as exact rationals and at 6

constants.GMsun: 1.327 124 4 × 10²⁰ m³ s⁻² (IAU 2015 Resolution B3, nominal; exact)
constants.thetaG: θg in µas = (M/M☉)·(GM☉/c²)/(D_Mpc · au): one au at one Mpc is one µas, π cancels, θg is an exact rational

massRows.label: EHT 2019 (the ring, GRMHD-calibrated)
massRows.read: θg ∈ [3.4, 4.2] µas (the measured angle; distance-free). For the clock (which needs M, not M/D): the stat and sys halves added linearly, M ∈ [5.6, 7.4] × 10⁹ M☉
massRows.source: EHT Collaboration 2019, First M87 EHT Results VI, ApJL 875, L6 (arXiv:1906.11243)
massRows.circular: this θg was derived FROM the 2017 ring with the GRMHD calibration, so the 2017 ring against this shadow returns that calibration: printed, never a test

massRows.read: M ∈ [5.12, 5.74] × 10⁹ M☉ at 16.8 Mpc (the distance term cancels in M/D and is dropped)

inputs.distanceFree: a dynamical mass scales as M ∝ D, so M/D (θg) is what the data fix, whatever distance is assumed: the comparison with the ring needs no distance and none is propagated (the scout's finding). The clock needs M itself, so it carries each row's distance. The distances 17.9 and 16.8 Mpc came from a search summary, not from each paper's own table

rings.published: 42 ± 3 µas, "across all methods, a crescent diameter"

rings.source: EHT Collaboration, "Horizon-scale variability of M87* from 2017–2021 EHT observations" (arXiv:2509.24593)

inputs.spin: a ∈ [0, 499/500] (0.998, Thorne 1974): ASSUMED, swept, never picked; |a| ≤ 0.998 by the mirror a → −a (checked below)
inputs.inclination: θo = 17° (the camera, the operator's ruling) and the band θo ∈ [13.9°, 20.5°] = 17.2° ± 3.3° (Mertens et al. 2016, A&A 595, A54, from the jet): ASSUMED. The EHT's 163° is the same curve mirrored (β² and α unchanged under cos θo → −cos θo)
inputs.diameter: W = max α − min α (horizontal extent), H = 2 max β (vertical extent), d̄ = (W + H)/2: a defined quantity, not "the" diameter

premises.premise: the Kerr metric (GR, uncharged, vacuum; no plasma lensing)
the critical curve in closed form (Bardeen 1973; Gralla & Lupsasca 2020)
each mass row's published 68% range read as a box
premises.standing: assumed (a box is not a hard bound on nature)

premises.premise: the ring the EHT measures (a fit to visibilities)
the ring-to-shadow factor (GRMHD-calibrated in Paper VI; a thin disk's lensing ring ~5% outside the curve, Gralla, Holz & Wald 2019)
premises.standing: compared, never decided: everything in the comparison rests on it

schwarzschild.claim: b_c = √27 M = 3√3 M: b² = 27 makes r = 3 a double root of r³ − b²(r − 2)

1/2.how: roots of r(r − 3)² = 4a² in [1, 3] and [3, 4] by exact rational bisection to 2⁻⁵⁰; signs at 1, 3, 4: 1, -1, 1

47/50.how: roots of r(r − 3)² = 4a² in [1, 3] and [3, 4] by exact rational bisection to 2⁻⁵⁰; signs at 1, 3, 4: 1, -1, 1

band17.band: d̄ ∈ [9.670896, 10.392772] M for every spin in the range
band17.read: min and max are each an enclosure of the extreme value over the range; the band is ⊆ [min.lo, max.hi]

bandIncl.deciders: the first decider alone (the second does not carry a wide inclination box); W and H are not banded over inclination

comparison.standing: COMPARED: ring ÷ predicted d̄ — the factor each row would need between the ring and the shadow edge. The factor is a calibrated premise (GRMHD), so this is a ratio band, not a verdict
comparison.circular: this θg was derived FROM the 2017 ring with the GRMHD calibration, so the 2017 ring against this shadow returns that calibration: printed, never a test

isco.formula: Bardeen, Press & Teukolsky 1972: Z₁ = 1 + (1 − a²)^(1/3)[(1 + a)^(1/3) + (1 − a)^(1/3)], Z₂ = √(3a² + Z₁²), r = 3 + Z₂ ∓ √((3 − Z₁)(3 + Z₁ + 2Z₂)); P = 2π (r^(3/2) ± a) t_g, coordinate time at infinity in the hole's rest frame (an observer sees it × (1 + z), z ≈ 0.0043, not applied)

secondDecider.rule: for every quantity the two enclosures intersect (both hold the true value); disjoint = a bug, the record refused

band17.note: a fixed spin grid, coarser than the first decider's branch and bound
